drivers.description: YoY revenue growth applied to prior period revenue.
EBIT as % of revenue. Implied by EBITDA margin minus D&A % revenue.
Income tax expense as % of PBT.
Inventory / Cost of Sales × 365. Zero for services companies; material for manufacturing.
Capital expenditure as % of revenue. Drives the canonical.cf.capex line item (the investing-activities line also reflects net other investing flows).
Net change in borrowings. ~0 when the company carries no forecast debt; present for generality.
Risk-free rate + beta × equity risk premium (CAPM).
Pre-tax cost of debt. Falls back to the debt schedule interest rate when unset.
Perpetuity growth rate. Must be < WACC (QA check).
Alternative terminal value via exit multiple.

wacc.source_notes: CAPM: Rfr=6.78% (INDIA market default for rfr (10Y sovereign yield %)), Beta=0.97 (Per-company registry benchmark beta vs primary index (0.95), Blume-adjusted), ERP=7.08% (INDIA market default for erp (Equity Risk Premium %)). Cost of Equity=13.62% = Rf + Beta x ERP. Pre-tax Cost of Debt=7.55% (after-tax 5.63%). Capital Weights: Equity=63.0%, Debt=37.0%.

dcf_bridge.debt_basis_note: Net cash = (cash + short-term investments) - total interest-bearing debt, as reported on the most recent balance sheet whose date is shown here. Debt is the issuer's own reported total, which already contains its lease component; lease liabilities are shown on this bridge for reference and are NOT added on top, because doing so double counts. Non-current investments are not netted. Note that a feed's debt total does not carry the full lease obligation of every issuer, so a provider that capitalises all leases will show a higher debt figure and a correspondingly lower net cash; the date and this basis are published so the two can be reconciled.

reverse_dcf.method_note: Solved exact implied perpetuity growth rate for market price INR 235.86 [DIVERGENCE FLAG: implied growth -7.53% outside sane band (-2% to 5%)]
